title: Spec & Design Agent structured result
description: Bounded result returned to the Conductor. See docs/ARTIFACTS.md. The Conductor alone owns state transitions and Trello updates.

status.description: spec_ready: reviewable spec committed. needs_decision: a material decision is missing. blocked: an input/integrity/access/environment precondition failed. failed: an unexpected execution failure occurred.

frozenArtifactSha256.description: Raw-byte hash of the frozen intent.md this run verified.

intentContentSha256.description: Normalized content hash carried from the freeze tuple as provenance.

specCommit.description: Present only when status is spec_ready.

specPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the committed spec.md. Present only when status is spec_ready.

specVersion.description: Integer spec revision. Present only when status is spec_ready.

blockingConcerns.description: Concerns that prevent Design Review. Non-empty implies status is not spec_ready.

nonBlockingConcerns.description: Concerns a human reviewer should see but which do not block routing to Design Review.

humanDecisions.description: Specific, material decisions a human must make. Non-empty implies status is needs_decision.
